mop_limits: MOP is 5 years from key collection for standard flats. We only know each block's lease start year, so this status is approximate (a block can reach MOP months earlier or later). Plus and Prime flats have a 10-year MOP; the data cannot identify them, and none has been resold yet. Blocks with no resale yet are not shown. Check HDB for a specific flat.
limits: Median of the last 24 months of recorded resales (data.gov.sg, to 2026-10) for one flat type, only where a block has at least 3 sales; other blocks are grey.
Flat size, floor and renovation differ within a block, so this is not a valuation or a forecast.
Remaining lease is in whole years (rounded down), from the lease left at each block's newest recorded sale.
